verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no custom report builder, scheduled exports, BI connectors, or reporting/warehouse API. The Dover API is described only as able to add candidates, list hires, and host a careers page, which is at most a developer building block rather than a reporting or export capability. The 'full visibility into candidates, costs, and conversion' line is a marketing claim that does not address building reports or getting data out, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse
